subject: ISV SDK collaboration: ToolkitLabs connector + tracing playbook
messages:
From: Andre Park <andre@toolkitlabs.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exploring an official ToolkitLabs connector for Redwood (SDK + tracing)

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for connecting at the Summit last week — great conversation about predictable inference and tracing. ToolkitLabs builds prompt tooling and runtime observability for ISVs; we’ve had several customers ask for a first-class adapter to Redwood so their teams can wire tracing and prompt-level metrics directly into existing tooling.

High-level ask: would Redwood be open to partnering on an official ToolkitLabs connector (open-source adapter + guidance) that includes:
- A lightweight SDK adapter compatible with LangChain / LlamaIndex calling flows
- Tracing hooks for span/context propagation and token-level timing
- Example prompts and a short integration guide for your docs site

We’re prepared to draft an initial SDK spec and provide engineering cycles (one SWE + one PM) to collaborate. Potential GTM: joint engineering blog + webinar after initial integration.

Would you be the right person at Redwood to start a short technical sync? If helpful, I can share a short spec and sample using LangChain.

Best,
Andre Park
Partnerships, ToolkitLabs
andre@toolkitlabs.ai

---
Toolbox: ToolkitLabs Integration Proposal (1 page)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Andre Park <andre@toolkitlabs.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exploring an official ToolkitLabs connector for Redwood (SDK + tracing)

Hi Andre — great to hear from you and glad the Summit follow-up is already moving. Thanks for the clear ask.

We’re definitely interested in exploring a supported connector. A couple quick notes and proposes next steps:
- Yes, please send the SDK spec (LangChain/LlamaIndex examples are ideal).
- Can we scope an initial POC that supports streaming chat traces, span IDs, and token timing? That matches a lot of our customers’ needs.
- I’ve looped in Marissa (partnerships lead) and Jonas (platform eng) to align on team side.

Availability: I can do a 30–45 min technical sync with your engineer next week (Monday or Wednesday morning PT works). If you prefer, share the spec first and we’ll triage offline.

Thanks — looking forward.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Phone: +1-415-555-0142

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exploring an official ToolkitLabs connector for Redwood (SDK + tracing)

Vanessa / Jonas — internal note before we jump on the call.

Quoted for context:
> On Fri, 10 Jul 2026 at 09:12 AM Andre Park <andre@toolkitlabs.ai> wrote:
> 
> ToolkitLabs builds prompt tooling and runtime observability for ISVs; we’ve had several customers ask for a first-class adapter to Redwood so their teams can wire tracing and prompt-level metrics directly into existing tooling.

Suggested plan / risks / owners:
- Quick POC scope (2–3 sprints): LangChain adapter -> trace exporter -> demo app. Owner: Jonas (platform).
- Security/compliance: confirm that trace payloads do not include PII by default; map fields to our telemetry schema. Owner: Vanessa to request sample payloads from ToolkitLabs.
- OSS & licensing: we should propose Apache-2.0 for the adapter; legal to review any joint IP clauses if they want co-branding in docs. Owner: Marissa to engage Legal.
- GTM: joint blog + webinar in Q4 if POC looks good. Marissa to draft comms timeline.

Action items before sync:
1) Andrew/ToolKit to share SDK draft and sample trace payloads (Vanessa to request).
2) Jonas to prepare a short compatibility matrix: supported runtimes, Python versions, recommended batch sizes, hooks for streaming.
3) Legal review on OSS license + quick NDA if they want early access.

I’ll summarize minutes after the sync and propose an MAP.

-Marissa
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Andre Park <andre@toolkitlabs.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: devs@toolkitlabs.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exploring an official ToolkitLabs connector for Redwood (SDK + tracing)

Vanessa / team — thanks for looping people in. Attaching a short SDK spec and a sample trace payload to help with triage.

Attachment: toolkitlabs-sdk-spec.md (3.2 KB)

High-level technical notes:
- Auth: we support API key + signed JWT; what’s your preferred auth flow for a connector published in docs?
- Tracing format: we export JSON spans with fields: span_id, parent_id, trace_id, start_ns, duration_ns, token_count, prompt_hash, model_name, user_id (optional). We can omit user_id by default or provide pseudonymous IDs.
- LangChain: we have an on_message / on_token hook in our LangChain adapter example.
- Delivery timeframe: our engineers can commit to a 4-week joint POC if we align on scope and auth.

Questions for you:
1) Does Redwood want token-level timing in the first iteration or should we start with span-level only?
2) Any constraints on telemetry payload size or frequency from the hosted side?

Happy to hop on a tech call next Tue (7/21) 10:00 PT if that works.

Best,
Andre
andre@toolkitlabs.ai

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Andre Park <andre@toolkitlabs.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exploring an official ToolkitLabs connector for Redwood (SDK + tracing) — mutual action plan

Andre / team — thanks for the spec. We reviewed it quickly with Jonas and legal is OK starting from Apache-2.0 for the adapter. Summary MAP (first iteration):

1) Scope (1-month POC)
- Deliverables: LangChain adapter + Redwood tracing exporter (span-level), example notebook, README + short integration guide.
- Token-level timing: defer to iteration 2 unless we see a strong customer ask; start with span-level metrics only.

2) Owners / timeline
- ToolkitLabs: provide final SDK spec + sample payloads by 2026-07-18 (Andre)
- Redwood (Jonas): compatibility matrix + POC environment by 2026-07-22
- Legal / OSS (Marissa): finalize Apache-2.0 template + quick NDA by 2026-07-20
- Joint demo & blog draft target: 2026-08-30

3) Security notes
- ToolkitLabs to default-strip user_id field unless customer explicitly enables it.
- Telemetry size guidance: keep individual span payloads < 2 KB; batch/export frequency should respect our per-request token limits. Jonas — please confirm any infra quotas.

4) Next steps
- Andre: upload final toolkitlabs-sdk-spec.md to the GitHub repo and share a DocuSign NDA link so Legal can review.
- Jonas / Vanessa: schedule 30 min tech sync 7/21 10:00 PT if that still works.

Attachments included: redwood-toolkitlabs-map.xlsx (starter MAP), nda-toolkitlabs-unsigned.pdf
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/templates/abcd-ToolkitLabs-NDA
GitHub (starter repo): https://github.com/toolkitlabs/redwood-adapter

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
